title: Subsets and Permutations
hints: Both are 'extend a partial answer, recurse, undo' problems. For subsets each element is either in or out; for permutations each position picks one element not used yet.

Subsets: recurse with a start index so each element is considered once, recording the path at every node (or loop over bitmasks 0 .. 2^n - 1). Permutations: keep a used array, or swap elements into place.
Append a copy (path[:]) when recording an answer; appending the live list is the classic bug that returns many identical lists.
